name: @bureaucromancer/lantern-schema
description: Magic Lantern's API contract and canonical types, as TypeBox schemas.
privateNote: Private until StoryEngine 3.0 starts (plan decision D4); StoryEngine uses link: dependencies or packed tarballs until then.
filesNote: `src` ships beside `dist` because every source map and declaration map names its source as `../src/…`: without it, go-to-definition in a consumer and `node --enable-source-maps` stack traces lead to files that do not exist. Tests and their helpers stay out, as does the build info. tools/pack-shape.test.ts checks the packed list.
dependencyNote: TypeBox only (plan, repository layout), so a third-party adapter can depend on this package and nothing else. 0.34.x rather than the unscoped `typebox` 1.x because StoryEngine composes these schemas with its own 0.34 ones, and two TypeBox libraries do not typecheck across that boundary; the two repositories move together. Ajv stays in the server for the same reason.
